The data sheets list \"1 x Console RJ45 port\" and are silent on the ETH management port's rate. 1g is taken from the TM-8104's OOB port on the maintainer's ruling for unstated management rates; the eth-speed gap stays open."},"front-layout":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"POSITIONS ARE THIS BOX'S OWN RENDER. telco.com 2024/09/TMC3308.png is rectified by a four-corner homography onto the data sheet's 221 x 44 (corners TL 4.5,174.5 TR 897,250 BR 896.5,436 BL 5,335.5 - a perspective view of a planar face, which the homography takes out exactly; about 4 px/mm, so good to about half a millimetre) and every jack, cage, lamp, pinhole and vent slot is placed where it lands. The NetZoom master was not used for positions: the same stencil's TM-3312 and TM-3348 masters were measured against their renders and put the jacks on the wrong pitch (see the TM-3312's front-layout)."},"jack-lamps":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"The render shows two lamp windows on the CON console, and STS and FLT printed under it name them. THE ETH AND CON LEGENDS ARE PLACED AS MEASURED, not centred: the render prints ETH about 1.3 mm below its jack's centre and CON about 1.2 mm above its own, both toward the gap between the two jacks, so L61 reports both and stays in the baseline for them on purpose, as for the SFP lamps. CON is not Ethernet, so it is the bare std/rj45-ganged@2 with the two windows placed beside it as common/led-rect-sm@1, for: con, at the corners where common/rj45-ganged-eth@1 draws its own - the family's way of drawing a lamped non-Ethernet jack (juniper/mx204's BITS)."},"lamps":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"PS1 and PS2 are about 3.5 mm green lamps, with a reset pinhole to their left, placed where the rectified render has them; LNK/ACT and MNG are printed over the ETH jack and STS and FLT under the CON jack, naming those jacks' own lamp windows. No document says what any state means; PS1 / PS2 presumably report the internal supply and the optional external one (see the power note)."},"model":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"TM-3308H data sheet (telco.com 2025/12), \"Carrier Ethernet/MPLS/IP SDN-Enabled NID\"; the 2019 edition calls it the T-Marc 3308/H, and the face prints TMC-3308."},"ports":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"Copper 1/1-1/4 are a 1 x 4 RJ45 row on a 14.1 pitch (centres 91.6-134.0) with lamp windows in the upper corners of every jack, drawn as common/rj45-ganged-eth@1 turned 180 (latch up). SFP 2/1-2/4 are a 1 x 4 ganged cage on a 14.55 pitch, centres 153.2-196.85, from the bright cage walls in the rectified render (145.9, 160.5, 175.1, 189.6, 204.1). Each has one oblong lamp to the right of its printed number, 1.0-1.2 mm right of the cage centre (lamps measured, and placed, at 154.4, 168.85, 183.35, 197.85) - so L61 stays in the baseline for these four ON PURPOSE: the lamp sits beside its numeral, not centred on the cage, and centring it would draw a face the unit does not have. Numbering as printed."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"\"Internal AC power supply with optional external AC power supply for redundancy (orderable separately)\" (TMC-3308-x), \"internal DC power supply (24/48VDC), dual feed power supply\" (TMC-3308-2DC, TMC-3308H-2DC), and \"TMC-3X0-EXTPS-x Optional, external redundant AC power supply\". Input 100-240 VAC or 24/48 VDC. No consumption figure is published. The supply is internal, so the front carries no bays; the inlet and the external supply's connector are presumably at the rear."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"Three data-sheet editions (2019-01, 2025-08 and 2025-12), five vendor renders of which telco.com 2024/09/TMC3308.png (about 900 px across the face) is the best straight-ish view, and the legacy NetZoom stencil \"Telco Systems\" (2022), master T-Marc 3308 (F).
